$comment: trustedPreviewDomains is NOT here: it names private networks, and this file is tracked in a public repository. Put it in .claude/claude-workspaces.local.json, which is gitignored and read first by .claude/hooks/auto-approve-preview-nav.ts. With no local file the hook matches nothing and Claude Code's normal approval prompt fires.

share.$comment: Per-repo Cloudflare Access share defaults. No default allow-list is committed here (this repo is public): the agent MUST ask the user which email domains to allow before sharing — never default to 'anyone'. defaultTTL is the share lifetime; the cf-access cookie + the registry entry both expire after this window.
